alignment.method: per-frame visible bounds, uniform visible-width normalization and rear-support pivot
alignment.notes: Alignment of generated frames; not a validated skeleton rig. Drawn body proportions and cropped source details still require review.

front_rebound.description: Michel: after push-off with sole right foreleg, head and forebody rise together like hopping/hinkelen.
front_rebound.interpolation: linear between frame angles during playback
front_rebound.method: Original forehand pose order, pitch, pivot and rebound retained; same-source continuous mesh only in rear lower region.

notes: Runtime playback order corrected after Michel observed a double forepaw tap. Original source pixels and old comparison modes unchanged. Contact annotation is pose review, not physical collision simulation.

rear_gait.draw_method: continuous rear mesh from the same source pose as the forehand; pinned upper and left boundaries; foot-anchor targets use selected rear timing
rear_gait.notes: Mixed-pose textures removed after Michel reported displaced pieces in frames 9–13. One source pose remains connected; mesh deformation is reduced if any triangle would fold. Rear timing and anatomical movement remain a prototype; not motion capture or a validated skeletal gait.
rear_gait.synchronization: One shared 16-phase cycle. Rear pose sequence rephased relative to unchanged sole-forepaw landing/rebound. Cyclic order retained; no independent clock.
rear_gait.rasterization: inverse triangle mapping with bilinear premultiplied-alpha sampling; shared output raster, no antialiased clip seams
rear_gait.foot_anchor_region_description: screen-left and screen-right hind paw endpoints measured from alpha > 200 in source rows 230..270; visual targets, not anatomical skeleton coordinates
